title: {session}.json (session manifest)
description: Created by step 2; appended by p2.0. cc_session_id is never overwritten (entry-flow audit trail); pid tracks the live claude main process and is refreshed on Path 2 post-context-clear init when the claude pid changes. See apex-core.md Conventions / Session manifest schema.

pid.description: OS pid of the live claude main process owning the session. Resolved at create-session.sh time via find-claude-pid.sh (walks up the process tree until comm basename == claude). Refreshed by apex-p2-init.sh on Path 2 post-context-clear init. NEVER set to a transient subshell pid - that would mark the session stale to sibling /apex.

cc_session_id.description: Entry-flow Claude Code session id; never overwritten

p2_cc_session_id.description: Appended by p2.0 after the p2.0c context clear
